parameters.name: Expired
parameters.description: Specifies whether the instances that you want to query expire.

parameters.name: Mix
parameters.description: Specifies whether hybrid queries are supported.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of instances returned on each page.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the instances you want to query belong. The value of this parameter can be NULL.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the instances that you want to query. Valid values:

*   **0**: shared instances
*   **1**: dedicated instances

example.unifiedCli: aliyun drds describe-drds-instances --type 1 --description drds_test --expired false --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --resource-group-id example-string --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --mix false --product-version V1 --tag Value=NEW_RETAIL Key=acs:newretail:domain --api-version 2019-01-23 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun drds DescribeDrdsInstances --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key 'acs:newretail:domain' --Type 1 --Description drds_test --PageSize 20 --ResourceGroupId 'example-string' --PageNumber 1 --Tag.1.Value NEW_RETAIL --Expired false --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ProductVersion V1 --Mix false
